name: Lagi El Nagil
original_name: ラギ エル ナギル
source:
A half-dragon with a mysterious condition that makes him transform into his dragon form if he gets too close to a girl. He likes to eat a lot and he's quite a sociable person, but he gets nervous when he's close to Lulu.

[edited from [url=http://wand-of-fortune.wikia.com/wiki/Lagi_El_Nagil]WOF Wikia[/url]]
